templates.title: The Missing Mascot Head
templates.briefing: The university mascot head vanished from the student-union storage room between 9:15 PM and 9:45 PM. Check the records against each suspect's statement before deciding who to hold.
templates.accessDescription: The campus card assigned to {name} opened the event-storage room at 9:37 PM, inside the theft window and after their stated departure time.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} returned to the storage room and took the mascot head.
templates.signInDescription: {name} signed in to help with student-union event setup earlier that evening.
templates.statementTemplate: I left the student union before 9:15 PM and was already gone when the head went missing.

templates.title: Dorm Common-Room Laptop Theft
templates.briefing: A laptop was taken from Hale Hall 2nd-floor lounge between 8:40 PM and 9:20 PM. Residents nearby are persons of interest. Match statements to door logs and lounge cameras.
templates.accessDescription: {name}'s hall fob opened the 2nd-floor lounge at 9:02 PM, inside the theft window and after they claimed to have left the floor.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} re-entered the lounge and took the laptop.
templates.signInDescription: {name} appears on the evening floor check-in for Hale Hall before the theft window.
templates.statementTemplate: I left Hale Hall lounge before 8:40 PM and did not go back upstairs.

templates.title: Assault Report — North Quad
templates.briefing: A student reported being shoved and threatened on North Quad between 10:05 PM and 10:25 PM. Witnesses disagree. Cross-check statements with badge pings and SOS app timestamps.
templates.accessDescription: A campus SOS beacon near North Quad was triggered by a device registered to {name} at 10:14 PM — inside the reported assault window, after they said they had already left campus paths.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} was on the quad during the assault window and initiated the confrontation.
templates.signInDescription: {name} signed the late-evening campus activities sheet before the reported incident.
templates.statementTemplate: I was off the quad before 10:05 PM. I never shoved anyone.

templates.title: Library Wing Vandalism
templates.briefing: Spray paint hit the science-library atrium wall between 11:10 PM and 11:40 PM. Facilities wants a hold decision tonight. Compare access readers with each alibi.
templates.accessDescription: {name}'s campus card opened the science-library atrium side door at 11:27 PM, inside the vandalism window and after their stated exit.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} re-entered the atrium and tagged the wall.
templates.signInDescription: {name} signed into the science library earlier that night.
templates.statementTemplate: I left the science library before 11:10 PM and did not come back.

templates.title: Dorm Fire-Alarm Pull
templates.briefing: A manual pull station in West Residences B-wing was yanked at about 1:18 AM, emptying the building. No fire found. Identify who pulled it before Housing writes everyone up.
templates.accessDescription: The B-wing pull station nearest {name}'s registered room logged a manual activation at 1:18 AM, matching the alarm and contradicting their claim they were asleep elsewhere.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} pulled the fire alarm in B-wing.
templates.signInDescription: {name} was marked present on the West Residences evening census.
templates.statementTemplate: I was not in B-wing when the alarm went off. I did not touch a pull station.

templates.title: Midterm Exam Key Leak
templates.briefing: An unreleased midterm answer key was photographed and circulated between 7:50 PM and 8:30 PM from the faculty copy room. Track who accessed the room after hours.
templates.accessDescription: {name}'s badge unlocked the faculty copy room at 8:11 PM, inside the leak window and after they claimed to have left the building.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} accessed the copy room and leaked the exam key.
templates.signInDescription: {name} signed the evening TA / course-assistant hours sheet before the leak window.
templates.statementTemplate: I left the academic building before 7:50 PM. I never entered the copy room that night.

templates.title: Keycard Cloning Fraud
templates.briefing: A cloned student keycard opened three restricted readers between 9:00 PM and 9:35 PM. One person's issued card matches the clone's UID pattern. Prove who ran the clone.
templates.accessDescription: A cloned card bearing {name}'s card UID opened restricted reader SVC-07 at 9:22 PM — after {name} claimed their card never left their pocket off-site.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} used a cloned keycard on the restricted corridor.
templates.signInDescription: {name} visited the campus card office earlier that day (replacement / encode window).
templates.statementTemplate: My card was with me all night off the service corridor. I did not clone anything.

templates.title: Chem Lab Equipment Sabotage
templates.briefing: A vacuum pump in Chem Lab 214 was deliberately unplugged and valves left open between 6:15 PM and 6:55 PM, spoiling an overnight run. Review lab door logs vs statements.
templates.accessDescription: {name}'s lab badge opened Chem Lab 214 at 6:41 PM, inside the sabotage window and after their claimed departure.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} re-entered Lab 214 and sabotaged the equipment.
templates.signInDescription: {name} signed the Lab 214 safety roster earlier that afternoon.
templates.statementTemplate: I left Chem Lab 214 before 6:15 PM and did not return.

templates.title: Admin Building Graffiti
templates.briefing: Fresh graffiti appeared on the Registrar annex exterior between 12:20 AM and 12:50 AM. Cameras caught a silhouette; badge pings may ID the person. Hold only with a contradiction.
templates.accessDescription: {name}'s card brushed the Registrar annex staff door at 12:33 AM, inside the graffiti window after they said they were already back in housing.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} returned to the annex and painted the graffiti.
templates.signInDescription: {name} clocked student-worker hours near the annex earlier that evening.
templates.statementTemplate: I was nowhere near the Registrar annex after midnight.

templates.title: Campus Bike-Rack Theft Spree
templates.briefing: Three locked bikes vanished from the Mill rack between 8:00 PM and 8:40 PM. Bolt-cutter marks on U-locks. Match statements to rack camera stills and tool purchases.
templates.accessDescription: A still at 8:19 PM shows a person matching {name}'s clothing profile at the Mill rack with a bag large enough for cut locks — after {name} claimed to be across campus.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} cut locks at the Mill rack during the theft window.
templates.signInDescription: {name} checked into the rec center earlier, placing them on the Mill side of campus that evening.
templates.statementTemplate: I never went to the Mill bike rack that night. My tools were for class projects.

templates.title: Fake Parking-Permit Ring
templates.briefing: Counterfeit hangtags were sold near Lot C between 5:30 PM and 6:15 PM. One seller's phone ping and a printer job may pin the organizer. Decide who to hold.
templates.accessDescription: Lot C gate camera timestamps {name}'s registered plate entering at 5:52 PM — during the sales window they denied attending.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} ran the fake-permit sales at Lot C.
templates.signInDescription: {name} visited Commuter Services earlier that day (permit questions on file).
templates.statementTemplate: I was not in Lot C during the sales window. I do not sell hangtags.

templates.title: Research Sample Theft
templates.briefing: A labeled cold-sample tray disappeared from Bio Store Room 3 between 4:10 PM and 4:45 PM. Chain-of-custody is broken. Find who re-entered after close.
templates.accessDescription: {name}'s research badge opened Bio Store Room 3 at 4:28 PM, inside the loss window after their stated checkout.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} re-entered the store room and removed the sample tray.
templates.signInDescription: {name} is listed on the Bio Store Room 3 afternoon cohort roster.
templates.statementTemplate: I checked out of Bio Store Room 3 before 4:10 PM and did not go back.

templates.title: Concert Backstage-Pass Forgery
templates.briefing: Forged VIP wristbands got four people into the union concert green room between 9:40 PM and 10:10 PM. Trace the printer job and who scanned the staff door.
templates.accessDescription: {name}'s event staff credential opened the green-room door at 9:56 PM after they claimed to have left the venue.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} used forged access to the green room and distributed fake wristbands.
templates.signInDescription: {name} appears on the evening concert staff / volunteer roster.
templates.statementTemplate: I left the venue before 9:40 PM. I never opened the green room.

templates.title: Missing RA Master Keys
templates.briefing: An RA key ring went missing from the duty desk between 11:00 PM and 11:30 PM. Several suite doors show unexplained unlocks afterward. Identify who took the ring.
templates.accessDescription: The key cabinet sensor logged an open under {name}'s duty login at 11:17 PM — after they said they had already handed off and left.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} took the RA master key ring from the duty desk.
templates.signInDescription: {name} signed the RA duty log earlier that night.
templates.statementTemplate: I finished duty and left before 11:00 PM. I never opened the key cabinet after handoff.

templates.title: Server-Room Unauthorized Access
templates.briefing: An unauthorized login and physical door open hit Comms Closet S-2 between 2:05 AM and 2:35 AM. Networking wants a name tonight. Compare statements to the badge trail.
templates.accessDescription: {name}'s badge and matching console login hit Comms Closet S-2 at 2:18 AM, contradicting their claim they were offline in housing.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} entered the server closet and performed the unauthorized access.
templates.signInDescription: {name} is listed on the IT student-worker evening roster.
templates.statementTemplate: I was asleep in housing. I did not badge into S-2.

templates.title: Blood-Drive Cooler Miscount
templates.briefing: Two labeled cooler inserts from the union blood drive went missing between 3:20 PM and 3:55 PM. Public-health staff need a hold decision. Check loading-dock access vs alibis.
templates.accessDescription: {name}'s card opened the union loading-dock door at 3:41 PM, inside the miscount window after they claimed to have left the drive.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} returned to the dock and removed the cooler inserts.
templates.signInDescription: {name} signed the afternoon blood-drive volunteer sheet.
templates.statementTemplate: I left the blood drive before 3:20 PM and never went to the loading dock.

templates.title: Stolen Union Wi-Fi Routers
templates.briefing: Two ceiling Wi-Fi APs were pulled from the student-union mezzanine between 7:05 PM and 7:40 PM. Ladder checkout and mezzanine door logs may identify the thief.
templates.accessDescription: {name}'s facilities-adjacent credential opened the mezzanine service door at 7:24 PM after they said they had already left the union.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} accessed the mezzanine and removed the Wi-Fi access points.
templates.signInDescription: {name} appears on the evening AV / tech volunteer roster for the union.
templates.statementTemplate: I left the union before 7:05 PM. I did not go up to the mezzanine.

templates.title: Unauthorized After-Hours Escort
templates.briefing: An unauthorized after-hours group was walked through a closed academic building between 1:40 AM and 2:10 AM, triggering alarms. Pin who badged the escort in.
templates.accessDescription: {name}'s card opened the closed academic wing at 1:53 AM and held the door long enough for a group — contradicting their solo-alibi claim.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} badged the unauthorized after-hours escort into the building.
templates.signInDescription: {name} filed an org night-activity form earlier (location claimed elsewhere).
templates.statementTemplate: I was not in any closed academic wing after hours. Nobody got in on my card.
